info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Bank Portfolio Management API
info.description: The Bank Portfolio Management API facilitates the administration and oversight of banking portfolios. It allows financial institutions to create and manage various portfolio configurations and transactions, ensuring optimal allocation of assets. Typical consumers of this API include bank administrators and financial analysts who require streamlined processes for portfolio adjustments and analytics. This API supports critical operations that enhance treasury management and strategic decision-making in banking environments.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new bank portfolio within the treasury management system. You can define specific parameters and attributes for the portfolio, which will be stored in the system for tracking and management purposes.
